description: Counts and topic share across eligible speakers in one house. Frequency is not a political position. UI must check coverage before scoring.

configuration.query: FROM hansard | WHERE house == ?house AND date >= TO_DATETIME(?from) | STATS total = COUNT(*), on_topic = COUNT(*) WHERE MATCH(text, ?topic) BY speaker_id, speaker_name | WHERE total >= 5 | EVAL share = TO_DOUBLE(on_topic) / TO_DOUBLE(total) | SORT share DESC | LIMIT 10000
